notes: All fifteen faces share one 2:3 paper silhouette. Unmodified original images are centered with contain; content, numerals and special SVG use the same original-aspect rectangle.
Normal eleven faces use independent soft framed scenes; earlier purple-gold draft assets are not included.

Special four original image bytes remain unchanged. Source-pixel-aligned optical texture overlays are limited to special painted motifs, without cat sweat, displaced artwork or new ornaments. Diagonal glare is removed from all cards; normal illustration motion is disabled.
Numeral areas occupy the upper 12–38 percent. Hidden and out cards receive no face image or value attribute.
Home artwork retains the approved four-friend composition with a four-limb bunny consistency revision; existing home animation is unchanged.
